title: Create a Custom Health Indicator
description: Implement a health check that verifies an external service and add custom info to /info.
problemStatement:
Extend your Actuator setup with customizations:
1. Create a custom health indicator that checks if a hypothetical external service (e.g., `https://api.example.com/status`) is reachable. Simulate the check (you can use a random boolean or a simple HTTP call). If reachable, return `Health.up()`, otherwise `Health.down()` with details.
2. Add a custom info contributor that adds a `build` section with artifact name, version, and a timestamp.
3. Ensure the /health endpoint shows the custom health indicator (it will appear as a component).
4. (Optional) Secure the Actuator endpoints so that only users with ADMIN role can access them, but /health and /info remain public.
hints: Use `RestTemplate` to call the external URL (or mock with `true`/`false`).
For info contributor, implement `InfoContributor` and add details.
To secure endpoints, add Spring Security and configure HttpSecurity.
expectedOutput: The `/health` endpoint should include a component named after your indicator (e.g., `externalService`). The `/info` endpoint should have a `build` object with the details you provided.
